Subject: Discovery snapshot & pilot sprint plan — access items + eval slate
Attachments: rwinf-poc-charter-v1.pdf, eval-prompt-set.csv

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick write-up to capture what we heard and a proposed 4-week pilot to validate fit. Please flag anything I missed.

Top pain points you described
- Intermittent tail latency (>500ms) on your realtime QA endpoint during spikes
- Embedding drift: similarity results vary across deployments and cost is high for high-concurrency queries
- Lack of prompt-level observability and rollout controls (hard to A/B without infra churn)

Primary goals for a successful pilot
1) P50 generation latency <120ms for 512-token avg workloads under our agreed concurrency (50 rps)
2) Reduce per-query inference cost by ~35% (via batching + quantized model) while holding quality delta <3% on your eval set
3) Produce an embeddings index refresh process with deterministic semantics and monitoring (mem/latency/delta alerts)

Proposed scope (4 weeks) — focused resources
- Week 0 (access & infra): IAM role or presigned S3 + sample subset of logs (10k rows) + Okta SAML test user
- Week 1 (deploy & baseline): deploy a Redwood-managed variant to your VPC (sandbox), run baseline evals using attached prompt set
- Week 2 (optimize): apply batching/cache heuristics, try a 4-bit quantized variant, validate regressions on prompt evals
- Week 3 (hardening): integrate token-level telemetry to your observability, run stress tests, document rollbacks and SLA behaviors

Success metrics we will instrument
- Latency: p50/p95 (target p50 <120ms; p95 <300ms on 512T)
- Cost: tokens-per-dollar and per-query unit cost delta vs baseline
- Quality: correctness on prompt set (accuracy) and hallucination rate (manual sampling) — target <3% quality regression

Owners & primary contacts
- Customer: Alyssa Morgan (product), Rafael Soto (DevOps)
- Redwood: Marcus Lin (AE, owner), Ben Carter (Solutions Eng), Kimberly Park (Customer Success / procurement)

Access & deliverables we need from Cobalt Data
- Sample dataset: S3 path with 10k rows (anonymized) or a DB read-only user
- IAM: temporary role or cross-account role we can assume for sandbox (details in attachment)
- Network: allowlist Redwood sandbox IP range (I'll share once schedule confirmed)
- Compliance: SOC2 report + any standard NDAs/PO terms you need to surface now

Attachments: I attached a one-page PoC charter and a small prompt-set CSV showing the eval slate we propose. I also linked an editable Drive outline for the success criteria.

Proposed next steps
1) Can you confirm the S3 path and a DevOps point of contact for cross-account role by EOD Thu (Dec 3)?
2) If procurement needs an MSA or PO, Kimberly is copied and can share the streamlined template.
3) Option: Kickoff demo + infra sync Tuesday Dec 6 — 30 minutes. Does that work for Rafael and your infra team?

Thanks — looking forward to getting a sandbox provisioned and running the first evals.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Marcus —

Appreciate the concise recap — this matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Security/compliance: we are SOC2 Type II (in process of renewing in Jan). Can you share the most recent SOC2 and standard redline exceptions you routinely accept? Procurement will want that up front.
2) Data residency: for the pilot we need to ensure logs and artifacts remain in our us-west-2 account.
3) Sandbox: Rafael (cc'd) will take point on the cross-account role. Rafael — can you confirm availability for a 30-min infra alignment on Mon Dec 5 or Tue Dec 6 (we prefer morning PT)?

We will aim to provide an anonymized S3 sample (10k rows) by end of day Thursday. Also flagging that procurement may request an invoice/PO before kickoff — Kimberly, I’ll loop you in separately if/when we need one.

Quick note: we want to prioritize the embeddings pipeline changes in Week 2 if possible (that will unblock a couple of search regressions we have).

Thanks — Alyssa

Thanks Alyssa — great, appreciate the timeline and Rafael joining. Answers & small updates below.

Security/compliance
- I'll share our SOC2 summary (redacted) via the Drive link; Kimberly can also surface the standard vendor exceptions we typically accept.
- For data residency: our Redwood Private sandbox will be provisioned in us-west-2 for the pilot and logs will remain in your account unless you opt to share aggregated telemetry.

Sandbox & IAM paths (two options)
1) Cross-account role: provide an AWS role ARN we can assume (recommended). We'll provide the minimal policy we need (list attached).
2) S3 presigned + short-lived service principal: if cross-account is not possible, share a presigned path and a service account email we can use for uploads.

Minimum IAM permissions we need (high level)
- s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on the sample path
- cloudwatch:PutMetricData (optional, for pushing telemetry to your account)
- sts:AssumeRole on the cross-account role

Updated timeline
- Thu Dec 3: confirm S3 path + Rafael availability
- Mon Dec 6: 30-min kickoff (infra + product) — we can do 9:30 or 10:30 AM PT; Rafael, which works?
- Week of Dec 6: deploy sandbox, baseline evals by Dec 10
- Week of Dec 13: optimizations + embedding pipeline changes (per your priority)
- Week of Dec 20: stress testing & handoff notes

Deliverables we will push by kickoff
- PoC charter (attached)
- Eval prompt set (attached CSV)
- Small runbook for cross-account role + allowlist IPs

Next steps (short)
- Rafael: confirm preferred kickoff slot (Dec 6 9:30 or 10:30 AM PT) and whether cross-account role is possible
- Alyssa: confirm S3 sample ETA (EOD Thu Dec 3)
- Kimberly: I'll let you coordinate procurement items (MSA / PO) with Alyssa as needed

If you prefer a live meeting before provisioning, Ben (copied) can do a 30-min infra deep-dive as well.

Best,
Marcus
